policy: Erratum: a defect in a pinned source (typo, wrong constant/sign, missing hypothesis, false as stated, gap). A gap counts as an erratum only when a printed assertion is false; a supplied argument for a true step is a deviation. Deviation: a deliberate difference of the formalization from the source (scope, conventions, reformulation, explicit parameter windows, proof supplements, different proof routes). Our own statement repairs are neither.

entries.claim: Proof supplement: local uniqueness modulo phase for flows. No published statement exists in this framework (GJLV05 Rem. 7: 'We do not formulate such a theorem'; HL19 Rem. 3.5 asserts it without proof). We prove it by adapting the map proof of GJLV05 §6 with the flow reducibility of §8 and Prop. 18, directly for flows (not through the time-one map, which needs map-Diophantine frequencies).. Proof written in blueprint Part 3: linearization at K₁ (not K₂), the phase fixed once by ⟨BLᵀ(K₂(·+ψ) − K₁)⟩ = 0, a uniqueness constant independent of γ (|ω| ≤ Γ from invariance, so γ ≤ Γ), the small-divisor exponent τ + n, and the conclusion on T_{ρ/2}
entries.effect: a gate theorem of our own; no source statement changes
